activationMetrics.metric: Guided-setup completion rate (install -> term dates + refund amount -> first runway number viewed, same session)
activationMetrics.target: >=80% of users who start setup complete it and see their number in-session
activationMetrics.rationale: Directly encodes upstream launch criterion and input-friction hypothesis: if manual/guided term modeling clears 80%, it validates bank-linked ingestion is not a hard v1 requirement.

activationMetrics.metric: Time-to-first-number (median seconds from install to first safe-to-spend value rendered)
activationMetrics.target: Median <=2 minutes; first number reachable in <=2 taps from app open
activationMetrics.rationale: Low friction to core value is critical for anxiety-avoidant users who abandon under cognitive load. Fast time-to-value is earliest signal ambient promise lands.

activationMetrics.metric: Setup abandonment rate by step (term dates, disbursement dates, refund amount)
activationMetrics.target: No single step accounts for >10% absolute drop-off; overall abandonment <=20%
activationMetrics.rationale: Localizes friction so engineering knows which onboarding field to fix.

activationMetrics.metric: Zero-unhandled-error activation quality (share of completed setups producing valid runway number with no error/null state)
activationMetrics.target: 100% of completed setups yield a valid number; 0 unhandled-error states
activationMetrics.rationale: For anxious users, an error at moment of first trust is disproportionately damaging; broken first number likely means permanent churn.

retentionMetrics.metric: Decision-moment return rate: share who open/glance at number near a purchase decision or disbursement events, NOT daily opens
retentionMetrics.target: >=50% check the number at least once in the week following disbursement or a spending decision
retentionMetrics.rationale: MUST NOT be pure DAU. Anxiety drives avoidance; rewarding daily opens would optimize for wrong behavior. Contextual, intentional return is the success signal for an ambient tool.

retentionMetrics.metric: Per-term / cross-disbursement retention (does user still have active, self-correcting runway at next disbursement cycle)
retentionMetrics.target: >=40% of setup-completers remain active through at least one full disbursement-to-disbursement cycle
retentionMetrics.rationale: Product's natural rhythm is the academic term, not the calendar day. Avoids the DAU trap entirely.

retentionMetrics.metric: Ambient-surface reliance ratio (share of number-views from widget/lock-screen glance vs full app open)
retentionMetrics.target: >=30% of number-views via widget/glance, rising over the term
retentionMetrics.rationale: Glancing without opening app IS intended healthy behavior for anxiety-aware, low-touch design.

retentionMetrics.metric: Passive-active health (share of active users keeping runway data fresh with minimal-effort logging/import)
retentionMetrics.target: >=45% of retained users have >=1 spend input/import per active week
retentionMetrics.rationale: Self-correction engine only works with data, but measures sustained low-effort input, not high engagement volume.

outcomeMetrics.metric: Runway-lasting rate: share whose spend stays within pace so funds last to next disbursement
outcomeMetrics.target: >=60% of active users reach next disbursement without depleting runway early (vs ~64-68% baseline of students who run out of money)
outcomeMetrics.rationale: The actual job-to-be-done. Beating the baseline is product-market fit.

outcomeMetrics.metric: Behavior-change / on-pace adherence: reduction in early-term overspend among users who recall their number
outcomeMetrics.target: Users trend toward on-pace spending; measurable drop in overspend-driven downward recalculations after week 2
outcomeMetrics.rationale: Directly tests value hypothesis that a single number changes spending behavior.

outcomeMetrics.metric: Perceived accuracy / trust score (in-app prompt: does number match lived reality)
outcomeMetrics.target: >=70% rate number 'about right' or better; correction rate trending down over time
outcomeMetrics.rationale: Tests accuracy-trust hypothesis. Anxious user only acts on a number they trust.

outcomeMetrics.metric: Self-reported financial-confidence / anxiety-reduction lift (pre/post-term short survey)
outcomeMetrics.target: Net positive shift in 'I feel in control of my money this term' among retained users
outcomeMetrics.rationale: Ultimate outcome is reduced financial stress, not more app usage.

businessMetrics.target: 1-3 design-partner campuses provisioned during MVP; pathway to 15-40 signed logos for operating break-even

businessMetrics.metric: Per-campus organic student activation (free-tier sign-ups + setup completion per pilot institution)
businessMetrics.target: Sufficient per-campus penetration to serve as aid-office sales evidence
Model ARR per pilot logo (e.g., 10k-student school @ $3 = ~$30k ARR) toward $1.5-5M SOM Y2

businessMetrics.metric: Deferred-bundle demand signal (in-app requests for bank-sync, subscription detection, splitting)
businessMetrics.target: Quantified latent-demand rate per excluded feature to gate v1.1 build decisions; capture volume only

businessMetrics.metric: Aggregation/COGS efficiency once bank-linking piloted (cost per active user vs Plaid $0.40-0.90 band)
businessMetrics.target: Track only if/when bank ingestion enters scope

leadingIndicators: Time-to-first-number and same-session first-number-view rate — predict activation and retention before D7/D30 data exists.
Step-level setup drop-off shape — predicts whether manual/guided input hypothesis holds and whether bank-linking becomes forced v1.1 dependency.
Early perceived-accuracy prompt responses (first-week trust score) — predict trust-driven retention long before term-end outcome data arrives.
Glance-via-widget adoption in week 1 — predicts healthy low-touch reliance, distinguishing intended ambient use from disengagement.
First self-correction event acknowledged without abandonment — predicts whether tool reduces rather than triggers anxiety.
Deferred-feature request rate in first 2 weeks — leading demand signal for v1.1 roadmap and unconfirmed bundle hypothesis.
Per-campus organic sign-up velocity in a pilot — leading indicator of institutional deal viability ahead of any signed logo.

sources.description: mvp-planning-agent.json — launch criteria, five learning experiments, instrumentation plan aligned to disbursement cycles
user-research-agent.json — anxiety drives avoidance contradiction; JTBD of making refund last the term; ~64-68% run out of money baseline
user-story-generator.json — 10 sequenced stories defining activation surface, self-correction behavior, ambient/widget glance surface
business-model-agent.json — institutional B2B2C revenue $2-8/student/yr, 15-40 logos to break-even, $30k ARR per 10k-student school, Plaid COGS, SOM Y2 $1.5-5M
Edvisors/Money.com + NASFAA survey baselines (~64-68% run out of money) used to set runway-lasting outcome target
iGrad/Enrich institutional comparable ($2-10/student/yr, 600+ institutions) validating price band and logo-driven break-even model

gaps: No pilot-cohort size or target institution set defined upstream; per-campus penetration targets and statistical power cannot be finalized.
Runway-lasting outcome baseline is population-level secondary data, not measured for this product's cohort; target is directional until a control/baseline is instrumented.
No confirmed method to observe actual end-of-term spending vs disbursement — outcome metric fidelity depends on unresolved input-completeness question.
Anxiety/confidence-lift measurement requires a validated pre/post instrument not yet specified; risk of survey non-response bias among avoidant users.
No fully-loaded burn model; 15-40 break-even logo count remains an estimate.
Contextual 'decision-moment' return-rate metric requires instrumenting intent/decision events, no defined capture mechanism yet.
nextSteps: Confirm pilot-cohort size and target institutions with mvp-planning-agent to set statistical thresholds.
Define runway-lasting control/baseline (pre-app spending self-report) so target is measured against this cohort, not only secondary data.
Co-design instrumentation event schema with engineering for anxiety-safe metric set.
Specify and validate short pre/post financial-confidence instrument with low burden.
Escalate: none of these targets imply a committed launch date; route any date to founder/human approval.
Flag to product-discovery-report-generator: outcome-metric fidelity depends on resolving manual-vs-bank-linked input-completeness question.
